name: grid-beam
title: Grid Beam
blurb: Animated beams pulse along grid lines with customizable colour palettes.
description: Canvas-based component with SVG grid lines and animated coloured beams that pulse through intersections. Supports multiple colour palettes (colorful, mono) and light/dark themes.
use_when: A dramatic, animated container background that can hold content and respond to an active state toggle.
avoid_when: Performance-sensitive contexts — continuous canvas animation. No prefers-reduced-motion support.
a11y: Canvas marked aria-hidden; content renders in a separate z-stacked slot above beams. No keyboard interaction on animation.
